name: pi-dev-ops-mods
description: Claude Code mods for the Unite-Group fleet, served from mods/ in this repository. Background auto-update needs no credentials because the repository is public.

plugins.name: mc-lane
plugins.description: Reports each Claude Code lane's tool calls (names and timings only), context use and cost to Mission Control.

plugins.name: ato-guard
plugins.description: In the ATO repository only: masks taxpayer identifiers (TFN, ABN, bank details) and Xero/Bearer tokens before Claude reads them, blocks Xero and SBR/lodgement writes, and keeps a local audit of counts only.
